title: Mizaj Milan: how two people fit
caption:
Compatibility isn't only for couples. It's for anyone you share a life with.

Mizaj Milan compares two people's types and elements: where you click, where you'll clash, and exactly how to handle it. Spouses, siblings, best friends, and that one parent you love but keep arguing with.

Both of you take the free test, then send a Milan invite link.

Tag the person you'd compare with first.
